_note: Limb zones of ordinary enemies (GDD limb-zones §3, §7). Rect per zone: [x0, x1, y0, y1], x in fractions of the hit box width w measured FORWARD from the feet (mirrored by face), y in fractions of the height h measured UP from the feet. attack_states: states in which a hit on the arm cuts it (wind-up and the blow). one_arm: stat multipliers after the arm is cut (the one-armed attack). drops_shield: the cut arm held the front shield. arm_colour: a stat key or a colour. arm_len px and arm_root [x, y] fractions: the flying arm piece and the stump. Kinds missing here have no zones (bat, bloat, jelly, crawler, wolf, dummy, bosses).
